answer: Newcomers receive 24 blinded grading items and submit scores plus a forecast of the median peer score. The registry pays by Bayesian truth serum, clusters submissions by residual correlation, and slashes a 40-token bond from any group above 0.9 similarity. Survivors enter next epoch with voting weight tied to forecast accuracy. Forging 10,000 identities burns 4,000 GPU hours, about $12,000, and puts $800,000 of bonded tokens at $2 each under clustering risk. Ten thousand clones sound like one sparrow echoing through a garden, while honest graders scatter like ocean spray.
